mapper.select: select ma.inst_id, i.inst_name, ma.dept_id, d.dept_name, ma.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, ma.account_id, a.login_id, u.user_name, ma.del_yn from t1500_manager_assignment ma join t1000_institution i on i.inst_id = ma.inst_id join t1000_department d on d.dept_id = ma.dept_id join t2000_complain_category cc on cc.complain_category_id = ma.complain_category_id join t1000_account a on a.account_id = ma.account_id join t1000_user u on u.user_no = a.user_no

select ma.inst_id, i.inst_name, ma.dept_id, d.dept_name, ma.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, ma.account_id, a.login_id, u.user_name, ma.del_yn from t1500_manager_assignment ma join t1000_institution i on i.inst_id = ma.inst_id join t1000_department d on d.dept_id = ma.dept_id join t2000_complain_category cc on cc.complain_category_id = ma.complain_category_id join t1000_account a on a.account_id = ma.account_id join t1000_user u on u.user_no = a.user_no where i.inst_id=#{instId} AND d.dept_id=#{deptId} AND cc.complain_category_id=#{complainCategoryId} AND a.account_id=#{accountId}
